packet_ref_policy: After this release is merged, export each packet from the resulting full main commit. Never reuse a historical packet or PR #4 output.
communication: Files only through immutable packets and private outboxes; no role-to-role messages or shared memory.
research_sequence: Create the Codex D04 proposer and Claude D05 proposer from separate frozen packets.
Commit each complete proposal before creating or releasing a challenger scientific packet.
Require each challenger to record an independent search and headroom estimate before receiving the proposer forecast.
Create the verifier session only after proposal and challenge artifacts are frozen and released.
Release only adjudicated objections back to the proposer.

deepseek.model_policy: Verification platform: use the observed deepseek-flash model at low effort for bounded source checks per docs/TEAM-DEEPSEEK.md, and record the actual host model and effort at creation.

claude.model_policy: Use only a Claude-family model exposed by the destination host. Record the exact model before the session receives scientific input; abort creation if no Claude model is exposed.

experiment_blockers: No accepted topic or agreed experiment task list exists.
Representative designs, macro-rich cases, additional corners and a qualified signoff oracle remain incomplete.

challenger.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13 (true UTC; 2026-10-14 local host date): the DeepSeek platform stops serving as challenger and becomes the project's verification platform; the dormant D04 challenger seat passes to a fresh Codex successor identity with no inherited context.

verifier.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: DeepSeek verifies both queues, replacing the platform that supplies the topic's proposer; D04 has no frozen proposal yet, so no verification work is lost.

challenger.reason: Owner-directed succession (PR #20), GPT-6-Astra at low effort with fresh context; the DeepSeek challenger filed and transported its round-1 challenge before the handoff.

verifier.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: DeepSeek verifies both queues; with a Claude proposal and a Codex challenge, the verifier is the third platform.
